name: Magic Hour
tagline: Magic Hour is a web-based video toolkit that turns text, images, or existing footage into finished clips. It combines image-to-video generation, AI avatars, face swap, anime-style conversion, and lip sync in one app, so creators without editing experience can still produce usable video. Marketing and social teams use it mainly for short-form ads and content, since it skips the usual steps of shooting and editing footage.
